name: mlflow_client_server_mismatch
title: MLflow client 3.x cannot log models to a 2.17.2 tracking server
command: docker compose -p builder-sbx-taxi-trip-regression -f compose.base.yml -f compose.sandbox.yml run --rm -T --no-deps serving-current make train SAMPLE=1
error_signature: API request to endpoint /api/2.0/mlflow/logged-models failed with error code 404
error_tail: 2026/10/08 14:37:39 INFO mlflow.tracking.fluent: Experiment with name 'taxi-duration' does not exist. Creating a new experiment.

2026/10/08 14:37:42 WARNING mlflow.utils.git_utils: Failed to import Git (the Git executable is probably not on your PATH), so Git SHA is not available. Error: Failed to initialize: Bad git executable.

mlflow.exceptions.MlflowException: API request to endpoint /api/2.0/mlflow/logged-models failed with error code 404 != 200. Response body: '<!doctype html>
The requested URL was not found on the server. If you entered the URL manually please check your spelling and try again.

cause.summary: Unpinned MLflow client 3.x against an MLflow 2.17.2 server
details: The Dockerfile installed the MLflow client with `pip install mlflow` (no version), which resolved to mlflow 3.1.4 on Python 3.9.
compose.base.yml runs the tracking server from ghcr.io/mlflow/mlflow:v2.17.2.
mlflow.xgboost.log_model() in the 3.x client first calls POST /api/2.0/mlflow/logged-models, an endpoint added in MLflow 3; the 2.17.2 server answers 404.
Training itself succeeded: the run and the experiment were created; only the model upload failed.

fix.summary: Pin the MLflow client to the server image's version
fix.action: Install mlflow==<version> where <version> is the tag of the MLflow server image in compose.base.yml (v2.17.2 -> mlflow==2.17.2), derived at render time so the two cannot drift.
fix.rejected_alternative: Upgrade the server image to 3.x: the tracking server is shared by every agent, so the client follows the server, not the other way round.

reproduce.how: Render the config files with an unpinned MLflow client install and run the sandbox; it fails at the train stage with the error_signature above.
reproduce.note: At the commit that adds this case the default render is still unpinned (`pip install mlflow`), so the plain command reproduces it.
